summary: Refined system architecture by integrating formal methods (ADTs, Curry-Howard, Monads) for type-driven reliability and implemented a semantic deduplication engine. These updates standardize error handling via a Result monad and shift the system toward agentic resilience, self-repair, and lean, relevant long-term context management.
key_learnings: Layering probabilistic filters and grammar-guided prompting ensures reliable, schema-compliant output.
Algebraic Data Types (ADTs) and type-driven development make illegal states unrepresentable.
Monads provide a robust design pattern for sequencing fallible operations and reducing silent failures.
Recursive error handling and lambda calculus reduction rules provide a formal framework for automated self-repair.
Semantic deduplication and cycle-based TTL prevent context dilution and stale reasoning.
